description: Accept-Language -> interface locale. The one vector table both negotiators are held to: backend/tests/test_locale.py (negotiate_locale) and frontend/tests/i18n-config.test.ts (negotiateLocale) read this file, so the two implementations cannot drift. A q-value must match the RFC 9110 qvalue grammar (0 to 1, at most three decimals); anything else makes its tag malformed and skipped.
